purpose: User-curated reference set for studying original creator craft. These links are inspiration inputs, not content to copy.
analysis_protocol: Observe the opening hook, question, visual progression, narration pacing, emotional turn, and ending invitation.
Extract transferable principles only; never reproduce a source's script, character, images, audio, or shot sequence.
Translate each useful principle into AION's own character-led, evidence-aware story grammar.
